title: Rav Ami bar Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Niddah 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.20b.23). In the same tractate, at [25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.25b.8), he says, “It was explained to me by Mar Shmuel himself.” Hyman infers that he was Shmuel’s student.

notes.text: At 20b Rav Ami bar Shmuel discusses examining blood between sunlight and shade.

The linked wording “Mar Shmuel explained it to me” is on 25b. [Hyman’s printed page, vol. I, p. 227](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3f/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._I._1910.pdf#page=258), gives 25a. The supplied Hebrew gives 28a. The analogous wording at [28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.28a.10) concerns Rav Nachman and Rav Huna. Hyman infers a teacher–student relationship from Ami’s remark.
